subtitle: Continual learning · Optimization
headline: AI Research Scientist at DRW
bioMarkdown:
I recently defended my PhD at [Mila](https://mila.quebec/en/) / [Polytechnique Montreal](https://www.polymtl.ca/), where I worked with [Prof. Sarath Chandar](https://sarathchandar.in) on continual learning and neural network optimization. I am moving to [DRW](https://drw.com/) as an AI Research Scientist.

My research studies how models adapt under distribution shift as new tasks or data arrive over time, and how loss landscape geometry can guide learning toward minima that generalize better. Highlights include [Manifold Metric](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.15895) (CoLLAs 2025, Oral), [Lookbehind-SAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.16704) (ICML 2024), and [Critical Momenta](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.09638) (TMLR 2024).

These projects owe a great deal to collaborators, especially [Aristide Baratin](https://arisbar.org/) ([Samsung SAIT AI Lab Montreal](https://www.sait.samsung.co.kr/saithome/mobile/about/labs.do)), [Razvan Pascanu](https://www.razp.info/) ([Google DeepMind](https://deepmind.google/)), [Quentin Fournier](https://qfournier.github.io/) ([Mila](https://mila.quebec/en/)), and [Gonçalo Mordido](https://goncalomordido.github.io/), as well as many other co-authors.

Before Montreal, I completed my MS at [IIT Madras](https://www.iitm.ac.in) with [Prof. Balaraman Ravindran](https://www.cse.iitm.ac.in/~ravi/) and [Prof. Sarath Chandar](https://sarathchandar.in) at [RBCDSAI](https://rbcdsai.iitm.ac.in). There I worked on [TAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.05155) (CoLLAs 2022) and [Causal Fairness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.14348) (ACML 2021).
